reason: An offline utility that locally encodes supplied text into QR codes and Code128 or EAN-13 barcodes, returning SVG, PNG, or ASCII representations without network or shell access.

summaries.zh: 在本地将文本生成二维码或 Code128、EAN-13 条形码，并以 SVG、PNG 或 ASCII 格式返回。
summaries.en: Generate QR codes and Code128 or EAN-13 barcodes locally from text and return them as SVG, PNG, or ASCII output.

capabilities: Generates QR codes locally from supplied text
